column1: # Executable T-27009 reconciliation batch; only symbols owned by src/main/8006CB30.c.
# Applied core ledger names and O.BIN names are retained. No file, field, type, const or comment rows.

column5: T-27009: schedule_init step 0; substeps restore_bgm except on DAY_EVENT_EXAM, hide the title, decrement last-date timers, poll the memory-card job, then mode_step_next.

T-27009: polls memory_card_job; result 0x13 plays audio command 0x50F, timeout >=0x201 or result 0xF0 plays 0x502, then stops the job; returns 1 once job is zero and clears memory_card_busy. Definition belongs to scheduler despite the memory-card topic.
T-27009: enables only command icon matching day_events[day_event_index].girl among icons 0..13; in ICON_MODE_FREE also disables icon 14 unless last_command low nibble is 14.
T-27009: in September clears player_flags_upper byte 0 bit 2 (overall player_flags bit 18); day_event_queue_build_week sets that bit when queuing DAY_EVENT_AMUSEMENT_PARK.
T-27009: girls 0..10 have last-date spots 0x23/0x24 reset to zero and girl_scene_bits cleared; calendar_advance_day calls it on every day of months divisible by three, not only month entry.

T-27009: month/year and quarter_flags choose progress_state entries to write as 1 or 0x80; also clears quarter_flags byte 1 bit 7 in November. Name describes the writes; interpreting these entries as date-place tips remains unproved and is not claimed here.
T-27009: clears bit 0 of clubs[0..10].unk_03; called by the queue builder for marker 2 in years 96 and 97.

T-27009: appends DAY_EVENT_GIRL_BIRTHDAY for Shiori and for met girls 1..10 with flag b6 when birth_day_check_days matches month+offset/day; appends DAY_EVENT_PLAYER_BIRTHDAY unless health nibble is 3; advances caller queue index.

T-27009: finds the weekday+1-th DAY_EVENT_DAY_END, backs the queue index over that day's records, converts subsequent DAY_EVENT_CLUB_MASTER_A records to DAY_EVENT_SCHOOL_DAY until DAY_EVENT_NONE; called by MASTER after its sequence.

T-27009: true only on 1998-02-15 with at least two met girls among 0..10 scoring >=501 from func_80053418, Miharu story_stage>=4, scene_flags[76/78] set, appointment 0 inactive and rand&15<5; builder then queues Miharu scene 4. No claim that this is her final scene.

T-27009: rand%3 gate, then command/parameter thresholds select the first unmet girl and scene; builder uses it when fewer than two girls 1..9 are met. Liberal arts/science/art thresholds 55/60/50; athletics girls 5/6, looks girl 7, trivia girl 8 and guts girl 4 have explicit arms.
T-27009: rand&7 gate and command/parameter arms like schedule_meeting_select_catchup with higher thresholds (liberal arts/science/art 75/85/65); builder uses it when at least two girls 1..9 are met.

T-27009: rand%3 gate; first unmet girl 1..6 in player's club is returned with a club-dependent scene and flag b18 set; girls 1..5 require practice_points>=21, girl 6 does not; girls 5/6 exclude Shiori in their club.

T-27009: switch(command%9) compares met command-associated girls' func_80053418 rank minus per-command bars with Shiori's adjusted rank; positive winner returned, else Shiori if positive, else 15. Builder stores result in DayEvent.extra and school-day code uses it for the companion.

T-27009: non-O.BIN name at 0x8006FB4C; sums girls' scene_counters[1..20], checks met/state/random and girl-specific scene_flags, writes girl/scene outputs and consumes flags/counters before returning 1; later Rei/Miharu/Mira arms do not require that initial sum. Normalizes owner prefix and bare event term.
T-27009: schedule_init step 4 calls calendar_advance_day, sends CD-audio command 9 if state mask 0x4 is set, then game_mode_set(MODE_DAY_SCREEN).
T-27009: day-screen stage 0 dispatches mode_step 0 to day_event_dispatch and step 1 to applied-core schedule_ending_start.

T-27009: requires met Yuina, func_80053418 points>=500 and highest points among girls 0..10 (ties favor lower id); rejects when Shiori<500, girl 12 flags byte3>=70 and scene_flags[79]==2. day_event_dispatch uses it for Yuina scene 7 when year>=98, month=2 and day=28; byte3 meaning and ending-candidate interpretation are not claimed.
T-27009: mode MODE_DAY_NOTICE; stage 0 runs vacation notice, stage 1 increments day_event_index and returns to MODE_DAY_SCREEN; draws HUD/background each frame.

T-27009: mode-step 0 emits the school-break notice, clears an active vacation or starts SUMMER/WINTER/SPRING in July/December/March, requests seasonal audio; step 1 waits for audio_bank_load_poll then starts bank 0 and advances stage; invalid step resets to title.
T-27009: MODE_MONTH_START stage 0 dispatches month loading; stage 1 increments day_event_index and returns to MODE_DAY_SCREEN; draws HUD/background.
T-27009: MODE_MONTH_START step 0 calls month-data load step; step 1 calls month-start music wait.

T-27009: reads 149 sectors from LBA 0x9B94 to 0x801A0000; on completion calls func_80068938(year,month,1); quarterly months refresh seasonal audio except 1996-09-01, run schedule_amusement_park_flag_reset and set D_800B5BC8=0xEF; other months advance stage directly.
T-27009: waits for audio_bank_load_poll()==1, starts bank 0 sequence 0 and calls mode_stage_next.
T-27009: MODE_WEEK_END stage 0 initializes HUD, stage 1 dispatches health checks, all other stages call func_800737A0 (school-day handler); draws HUD/background.
T-27009: initializes parameter display, hizuke and message window, then mode_stage_next; stage 0 of the weekly health mode.
T-27009: increments mode_step_timer, dispatches steps 0/1/2/3/5/6/7 to health roll, injury/neurosis/sickness onset and their recovery handlers; any other step selects stage 255.

T-27009: health nibble, condition, stress and min(254,204+guts/8) select onset/recovery steps; healthy recovery-days gate suppresses onset, injured/neurotic recovery overwrites a simultaneous sickness test, sickness may select a met girl's sick visit; no change advances to stage 255.

T-27009: injury text sets health nibble 1; waits >=61 frames then >=257 or pad_pressed; final substep can start Miharu scene 2 with scene_flags[75]==0, vacation NONE and frame_count&255<25, else stage 255.
T-27009: neurosis text sets health nibble 2; after >=61 frames waits for >=257 or pad_held then selects stage 255.
T-27009: sickness text sets health nibble 3 and starts audio bank sequence 0x202; after >=61 frames waits for >=257 or pad_held then selects stage 255.
T-27009: injury-healed text clears health nibble and sets recovery-days bits to 3; after >=61 frames waits for >=257 or pad_held then selects stage 255.
T-27009: neurosis-healed text clears health nibble and sets recovery-days bits to 3; same >=61/257-frame or pad_held wait, then stage 255.
T-27009: sickness-healed text clears health nibble and sets recovery-days bits to 3; same >=61/257-frame or pad_held wait, then stage 255.

T-27009: owned data range 0x800B6740..0x800B6760 in config/objects/main.txt; builder sets -1 and geko_judge/date_sasoi_judge reject the last returned girl before storing their next result. Prevents consecutive repeats across these selectors; does not ban A,B,A in one build.
T-27009: scheduler-owned s32; schedule_command_girl_select subtracts it from girls 1/5/6 rank and Shiori's liberal-arts rank; command arms 0 and 3.
T-27009: scheduler-owned s32 subtracted from girl 3 and Shiori rank by schedule_command_girl_select in command arm 2.
T-27009: scheduler-owned s32 subtracted from girl 8 and Shiori rank by schedule_command_girl_select in command arm 5.
T-27009: scheduler-owned s32 subtracted from Shiori rank by schedule_command_girl_select in command arm 3; girls 5/6 use the separate liberal-arts/athletics bar.
T-27009: scheduler-owned s32 subtracted from girl 2 rank for command 1, girl 7 rank for command 6 and Shiori rank in both arms of schedule_command_girl_select.
